title: Valid Word Abbreviation
description: Determine if a string matches an abbreviation by parsing numeric components.
pseudocode:
1. i = 0, j = 0
2. while j < abbr.length:
3.   if isDigit(abbr[j]):
4.     num = parseNumber()
5.     i += num
6.   else if abbr[j] == word[i]:
7.     i++, j++
8.   else: return false
9. return i == word.length

steps.note: Initialize pointers i and j to 0
Check if i reached the end of word
